finalText:
All 12 leftover files are moved over to `db.execute({ sql, params })` now. That covers macroAdmin, teamService, cohort, sla, apiKeyAdmin, session, returnService, couponService, shipment, refund, supplier, and variantAdmin.

One spot still uses the old call: `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`. I left it alone since it's a vendored file marked "do not edit — replaced wholesale on every upgrade." Worth handling separately, maybe by wrapping it or upgrading the vendor package.
